name: Yakumo Kiyoshi
source:
The leader of the Yagumo Group.
He built up the Yagumo Group, which he founded himself, into a large organization in a single generation.

He has built an era based on his creed of never laying a hand on honest people.

He has connections in the political and business worlds, and even in his old age, he still wields strong influence.

He dotes on his granddaughters, Rio and Mimu.

[Translated from [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/guiltyex/ex03/chara.html]the official site[/url]]
